blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — The 10th Infantry Division (10ID) has bolstered its frontliners for the Armed Forces of the Philippines’ Comprehensive Archipelagic Defense Operations (CADO), welcoming 28 newly assigned second lieutenants to reinforce its officer corps in territorial defense and external security operations. The new officers formally joined the division on Monday during a flag-raising ceremony at Camp General Manuel T. Yan Sr. in Mawab, Davao de Oro, where Maj. Gen. Alvin Luzon, 10ID commander, led the donning of the unit patch to mark their integration. “The 10ID welcome the 28 newly assigned officers as they join the ranks of […]...
